name: Sparse Volume Rendering with Block Walking and Culling
aliases: Hardware Ray Tracing Sparse Volume Rendering
Sparse Volume Rendering with Block Walking and Block Culling
definition: A method to render sparse volumetric data using hardware ray tracing. It uses a two-level sparse data structure (blocks containing subblocks) and accelerates traversal by storing adjacency information in BVH nodes to skip ray-tracing queries for adjacent blocks (Block Walking) and using density-based culling masks to skip irrelevant blocks (Block Culling).
summary: Sparse Volume Rendering with Block Walking and Culling efficiently renders sparse volumetric data by using hardware ray tracing with block walking to skip API calls and block culling to skip irrelevant blocks.
